name: Style-Bert-VITS2 Bridge
description: Local speech and voice-production bridge for Style-Bert-VITS2, Irodori-TTS, and speech.cpp.

irodoriExpressiveText.description: Opt in to provider-aware Irodori audio-only expression guidance. Requires the host prepareSpeechPromptContext API and conversation/prompt hook permission. Uses all 45 documented annotations; never changes TTS auto mode or adds Qwen stage directions.

pronunciationReplacementsPath.description: SBV2 bridge pronunciation dictionary: JSON object mapping prose terms to readings. Configure under tts.providers.style-bert-vits2. Read and merge an existing dictionary; ~/ is expanded and relative paths use the Gateway process cwd. Inline pronunciationReplacements take precedence. See skills/voice/references/pronunciation-replacements.md. Not the upstream SBV2 user_dict or an Irodori/speech.cpp setting.

pronunciationReplacements.description: Inline SBV2 prose pronunciation replacements (term -> reading), configured under tts.providers.style-bert-vits2. Override matching entries from pronunciationReplacementsPath. Case-sensitive literal replacement, longer keys first; not for URLs, logs, commands, or JSON. See skills/voice/references/pronunciation-replacements.md.
